description.value:
Frequency once per day

Raise one Afflicted per available corpse in the burst, up to 8 (standard level rule, −2 per Afflicted beyond the first — so a mass raise produces a crowd of weak bodies, by design). They may exceed your normal cap, and can be group-Commanded as Choir Practice.

cinderfall.incomplete: Raising/creating a new minion or ally creature (P-SUMMON) has no system.rules representation. Real pf2e itself ships rules: [] for the equivalent case (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/spells/spells/rank-1/summon-undead.json, system.summons left unpopulated too), but per this pass's own convention that is evidence of the gap, not license to treat the clause as correctly-empty -- it is dispositioned INCOMPLETE, not SKIP.
